newsitem.title: USA: Encore Computer delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Encore Computer delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Encore Computer Corp said Friday it was notified by Nasdaq that its stock is no longer eligible for inclusion on the Nasdaq system.
The company said its stock will trade on the OTC Bulletin Board under the symbol "ENCC."
Nasdaq took action because Encore was unable to meet the exchange's equity requirements, the company said.

"Encore will work diligently to cure its deficiency and get re-listed on NASDAQ as soon as possible," said Kenneth Fisher, chairman and chief executive of Encore, a computer company that provides real-time data storage, data retrieval, and data sharing technologies for mixed platform processing environments.
